intro.en: A grid is a set of horizontal and vertical lines that divide a screen into columns and rows. It is one of the most important principles in UI Design, and one that beginners consistently find confusing. This chapter covers grid anatomy, why grids matter, the two grid types, the maths for building a column grid, and the 8pt system you will actually use day to day.
